Isometric sprite set · carrier and air wing · 8 facings

Lancer Fleet Sprites

Every frame here is rendered, not drawn. Each craft is described once as a small 3D model of boxes, ellipsoids and cylinders grouped into swappable modules; each animation poses that model, and the pose is rotated in 45° steps and projected through a fixed isometric camera. The carrier and the fighters that launch from it share one camera, one light rig and one palette, so they agree by construction — the squadrons in the carrier's launch animation are the fighter model itself, scaled down.
